evidence.reason: The visible `Outbox.acknowledge` implementation checks only that `value["id"]` is present in `remote_ids` and then writes the ack without comparing the retained payload to the fetched record. `Outbox.spool` already treats a same-id/different-payload replay as an `IntegrityError` (lines 528-531), so silently acknowledging a divergent retained payload hides it from `pending()` and suppresses the conflict. The replay should compare the retained payload with the fetched record and raise on mismatch instead of acknowledging it.
